entities.text: High Court Of Orissa At Cuttack
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the Petitioner and the State.

2. By means of this application under Section 438 Cr.P.C., the Petitioner seeks anticipatory bail apprehending their arrest on the alleged offence under Sections. 363/366/376(2)(i)/109/506/34 of IPC, R/w. Sections 6 of POCSO Act in connection with Baliapal P.S. Case No.122 of 2023 corresponding to Special Case No.131 of 2023 pending in the court of learned A.D.J-Cum-Spl. Court under POCSO Act., Balasore.
3. Having regard to the allegations in the F.I.R., since the Petitioner has been arrayed in the offence under the POCSO Act it is not desirable for this Court to grant the anticipatory bail.

However, it is directed that in the event the Petitioner surrenders and moves for bail before the learned court below, the learned court in seisin over the matter shall dispose of the bail application of the Petitioner on its own merit being alive of the position of law on bail keeping in view the gravity of the offences, as far as possible taking into // 2 // consideration the materials on record as well as other documents available on record on its own merit, as far as possible on the same day if there be no other legal impediment The court shall apply its wisdom in allowing or rejecting the application.
4. The ABLAPL is disposed of accordingly.
(Chittaranjan Dash) Judge Bijay
